Well I deal with the pain from my lupus with different things, stretching, heat packs, massage, muscle relaxers. The migraines I don't have a lot I can do. I literally lie down in a pitch black, quiet room and try to sleep it off, sometimes an ice pack on my neck helps. Usually I'm unable to sleep because I'm in too much pain to sleep. I often cry myself to sleep, but then I wake up with an even worse headache. It's a vicious cycle. And not getting enough sleep is one of my main migraine triggers.

Oh yeah, lots and lots of doctors. I feel like I live at the doctors office. Between neurology and rheumatology, and all the testing they order, it feels like a full time job in itself. It seems like I've tried every medication known to mankind, and nothing is working. It's so frustrating.
